parsed.answer: Similar reports exist. In both, WSL stopped starting after an update with Wsl/Service/CreateInstance/CreateVm/.../HCS/ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND, because it could not find C:\Program Files\WSL\system.vhd. Your ticket doesn't show that path, so check that first: see whether C:\Program Files\WSL\system.vhd exists. What worked in those tickets: (1) Run the WSL MSI installer from the GitHub releases page and choose 'Repair' (right-click the MSI), or uninstall WSL completely and reinstall. Your 2.7.13 installer ran fine and fixed ubuntu.exe, so staying on 2.7.13 is a valid fix for now. (2) As a dirty workaround, one reporter copied C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\WSL\system.vhd to C:\Program Files\WSL\system.vhd, and WSL then started. In WSL#13948, running `wsl --update` fixed it for one user, but the error persisted for others. The tickets don't confirm that 2.7.14 is the cause. If 2.7.14 keeps failing silently, collect logs with collect-wsl-logs.ps1 and file them with this ticket. Your Ubuntu data was untouched in the related reports.
